g.text: codeintel — Query Engine: two independent paths
There is no orchestrator and no automatic fallback. server.py exposes flat tools; the AGENT decides which path to call.
no router · no fallback · no query classification
goToDefinition · findReferences · callHierarchy · documentSymbols · typeHierarchy · getIndexStatus
Exact ranges, not matches: turns "50 files mention this symbol" into "defined here, called at these 3 sites".
RRF: each source contributes independently, so a hit found by BOTH ranks higher than either alone. Zoekt is a TRIGRAM index doing substring/regex
matching — not BM25, and not scored by term frequency. The 500-char cap and limit=10 are fixed caps, not context-window-aware budgets:
codeintel does not count the agent's tokens. Transport is stdio JSON-RPC only — no HTTP, so no SSE streaming.
